answer: A bond is refunded only after 37 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. The voyage counter is kept in pearl and dawn shows each reset. A hostile operator thus has to keep every sock puppet continuously active for 37 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A farm of 3069 identities would post 4114 proofs and burn roughly 8 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
